edges.reason: The column-addition criterion explicitly carries a completed ten. Teaching that exchange inside the column lesson still supplies the carrying concept represented in the oral-addition endpoint. Gemini identifies this necessary content; restrict the edge to carrying meaning rather than prior mental two-digit fluency.
edges.scope: The base-ten carrying meaning when ten ones are regrouped as one ten in column addition

edges.reason: Column addition reinforces place-value alignment and regrouping. Mental hundreds/tens sums can be obtained by decomposition and unit counts without laying out written columns.
Mental arithmetic on hundreds and tens uses the values of those places in three-digit numbers.
Longer column sums motivate efficient regrouping. Commutativity and associativity can be understood and used on small or round-number mental sums without the written three-digit procedure.
edges.scope: verifying and applying addition laws on larger numbers
